title: On indecomposable elements in lattices
summary: We study the distribution of indecomposable elements in Euclidean lattices. A positive element in a lattice is called indecomposable if it cannot be represented as a sum of two other positive nonzero elements. The set of all indecomposables in a lattice forms the Hilbert basis for the positive lattice semigroup. We classify lattices that contain only finitely many indecomposables versus those that contain infinitely many.
